_what_this_is: An example --template for report.py. Copy it, edit it, pass it with --template. Every key is optional and falls back to the built-in default; a key this file does not know about is carried along and ignored, so a company template can keep its own bookkeeping in here. Keys starting with _ are comments.
title: Flow study -- CFD report
subtitle: prepared for the customer, from the study's own artifacts
_front_matter: Fixed lines printed under the study identity on the cover: whatever has to appear on every document you send. They are printed as given and nothing checks them.
front_matter: Method: OpenFOAM, settings reproduced in the methods section
_sections: The order the sections are written in, and which are written at all. Known: summary (cover, key numbers, hero figure), figures, methods, gaps (what was asked for and not produced). A name this does not know is reported and skipped; an empty or all-unknown list falls back to all four.
_footer: One paragraph at the foot of the cover.
footer: Numbers as produced. Whether they are converged, mesh independent or right is not decided here.
